subject: LTKO
title: Beginning Korean: First Year I
description: Students develop beginning-level skills in the Korean language, beginning with an introduction to the writing and sound system. The remainder of the course will focus on basic sentence structures and expressions.

subject: LTKO
title: Intermediate Korean: Second Year I
description: This course will help students develop intermediate-level skills in the Korean language. Upon completion of this course, students are expected to have good command of Korean in various daily conversational situations.
prerequisites_text: LTKO 1C or placement test and consent of instructor.

description: This course will help students develop intermediate-level skills in the Korean language. Upon completion of this course, students are expected to have a good command of Korean in various daily conversational situations.
prerequisites_text: LTKO 2A or placement test and consent of instructor.

title: Intermediate Korean: Second Year III

subject: LTKO
title: Advanced Korean: Third Year I
description: Students will learn advanced level skills in listening, speaking, reading, and writing Korean, and expand their understanding of Korean culture. Topics: living in Korea, popular Korean food, dating culture in Korea, tour sites and regional products, Hallyu—Korean Wave. Students may receive a combined total of twelve units for LTKO 130, LTKO 130F, LTKO 130W, and LTKO 130P.
prerequisites_text: LTKO 2C or equivalent level of proficiency with consent of instructor.

subject: LTKO
title: Advanced Korean: Third Year II
description: Students will learn advanced level skills in listening, speaking, reading, and writing Korean, and expand their understanding of Korean culture. Topics: address terms and interpersonal relations, famous Korean people, Seoul—capital city of Korea, South Korea and North Korea, housing in Korea. Students may receive a combined total of twelve units for LTKO 130, LTKO 130F, LTKO 130W, and LTKO 130P.
prerequisites_text: LTKO 2C or equivalent level of proficiency with consent of instructor.

subject: LTKO
title: Advanced Korean: Third Year III
description: Students will learn advanced level skills in listening, speaking, reading, and writing Korean, and expand their understanding of Korean culture. Topics: customs and superstitions, Korean folktales and proverbs, Korean culture of community, Korea during the Japanese colonial period, Korea and Korean. Students may receive a combined total of twelve units for LTKO 130, LTKO 130F, LTKO 130W, and LTKO 130P.
prerequisites_text: LTKO 2C or equivalent level of proficiency with consent of instructor.

subject: LTKO
title: Readings in Sino-Korean Characters
description: Students in this course will learn advanced and superior level Sino-Korean vocabulary and characters, skills in reading and understanding advanced and superior level Korean reading materials, and expand their understanding of Korean culture. Upon completion of this course, students are expected to have acquired an expanded vocabulary, knowledge of various expressions using Sino-Korean vocabulary and characters.
prerequisites_text: LTKO 2C or equivalent level of proficiency with consent of instructor.

subject: LTKO
title: Readings in Korean Literature
description: Readings in Korean literature and culture from colonial period to present. May be taken for credit up to three times as topics vary.
prerequisites_text: LTKO 130F or LTKO 130W or LTKO 130F or equivalent proficiency with consent of instructor.
